gen-gf-aboreto-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Aboreto spaces its capitals wide, stout stems joined by hairline arms fine as thread. Be Vietnam Pro follows as a plain sans of round bowls, every stroke bent from one steel rod, so the heavy heading never gets crowded.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-epilogue: Commanding, and a little fragile: Aboreto hangs hairline joins between massive stems. Epilogue is a wire-like monoline sans-serif with curvy, unclamped letters, so if the heading shrinks, its delicate links fade while the body stays sturdy.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-fira-sans: Expressive Aboreto builds each letter from fat anchors and filament-fine links, which suits large sizes. And Fira Sans draws every stroke as stout as a pipe cleaner, so if the heading goes small, the body will outweigh it.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans stands tall, its lowercase sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans can be sized up a notch without losing that sturdiness, while Aboreto's steep stem-to-hairline contrast stays on top.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, a sturdy lowercase with broad open counters that never feel cramped. Aboreto above it is all heavy pillars joined by fine wires.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-ranade: Ranade reads organic and spread out, its weight shifting only slightly, like stretched rubber cord, across widely spaced letters. Aboreto does drama, stout stems and slender hairlines; Ranade just keeps going.
gen-gf-aboreto-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, a thick, heavy-looking band of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. And over many lines it stays steady, a firm floor under Aboreto's chunky downstrokes and threadlike crossbars.
gen-gf-aboreto-general-sans: General Sans reads with the steady pressure of one pen, its tall x-height filling the line and every bend smooth. Aboreto's heavy stems and hairlines frame it nicely.
gen-gf-aboreto-manrope: Manrope keeps one pen width throughout, with a bright open gap at the mouth of every curved letter. Aboreto earns its keep big and brief, where its drastic thick-and-fine strokes can show.
gen-gf-aboreto-montserrat: Geometric and approachable, Montserrat glides under the eye with oversized e and a counters. Aboreto's heavy stems dwarf their own hairlines, and that drama against Montserrat's smooth lines is the pair's best trick.
